title: BBQ Sausage Loaded Potatoes

method.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (200°C fan) or air fryer to 200°C. Toss potatoes with olive oil, paprika, salt and pepper. Spread on a baking tray and roast for 20–25 mins, flipping halfway, until golden and crispy.
While the potatoes cook, heat a frying pan over medium heat. Cook sausages for 8–10 mins, turning until browned and cooked through.
Slice the sausages into bite-sized pieces.
Once the potatoes are done, top with sliced sausages and sprinkle over the grated cheddar cheese.
Pop back in the oven for 2–3 mins, or until the cheese is melted and gooey.
Drizzle with BBQ sauce, add a dollop of sour cream (or mayo) and sprinkle with spring onions.
Serve immediately and enjoy!

tip: Add jalapeños or swap cheddar for mozzarella for a different twist.

method.text: Sprinkle with spring onions, sesame seeds and a drizzle of mayo (optional).

tip: Add a pinch of chilli flakes for extra heat or swap the chicken for crispy tofu.

title: Sticky Maple Sausage Traybake
subtitle: Sweet, savoury and packed with flavour!

method.title: Prep the veg
method.text: Preheat oven to 200°C (fan 180°C). Chop the baby potatoes, red pepper and red onion into chunks. Place them on a large baking tray.

method.title: Make the glaze
method.text: In a small bowl, mix together maple syrup, soy sauce, minced garlic, mixed herbs, a drizzle of olive oil, salt and pepper.

method.title: Add everything
method.text: Nestle the sausages into the tray with the veg. Pour over the glaze and toss everything together so it's well coated.

method.title: Bake
method.text: Cook in the oven for 30 minutes, turning halfway through, until the sausages are golden and the veg is tender and caramelised.

method.title: Serve & enjoy
method.text: Spoon onto plates and drizzle over any extra glaze from the tray. Add a sprinkle of fresh herbs if you have them.

tip: For extra flavour, add a pinch of chilli flakes or swap the potatoes for sweet potatoes!
notes: Printed 'Total: ~ £7.83, That's £1.96 per serving!' (matches the listed prices). Script word 'Sticky Maple' above 'Sausage Traybake'. Tagline 'Aldi Ingredients Real Prices Great Meals'. Quantities are pack sizes as printed.

title: Sticky Teriyaki Sausage Rice Bowls

method.text: Cook the rice according to the pack instructions.
Fry the sliced sausages in a little oil until browned and cooked through.
Add the peppers and garlic and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until softened.
Stir in the teriyaki sauce and soy sauce, then add a small splash of water if needed.
Toss everything together until the sausages are sticky and glossy.
Serve over the rice and finish with spring onions and sesame seeds.

tip: Use a microwave rice pouch instead of dry rice if you want this on the table even faster.
notes: Header chips: Total Price £6.12, Cook Time 20 mins, Serves 4, Calories 527 per serving. 'Ingredients & Method' under the title is a section label (subtitle null). Last three ingredients (oil, salt & pepper, splash of water) come from the 'Pantry' box. Equipment: saucepan, large frying pan or wok, knife & chopping board.

title: Sweet Chilli Chicken Noodles

method.title: Cook the noodles
method.text: Cook the egg noodles according to the pack instructions. Drain and set aside.

method.title: Prepare the chicken
method.text: Cut the chicken into thin strips. Season with a little salt and pepper.

method.title: Fry the chicken
method.text: Heat a large pan or wok with a little oil. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 5–6 minutes until cooked and lightly golden. Remove from the pan and set aside.

method.title: Stir-fry the vegetables
method.text: In the same pan, add a little more oil. Stir-fry the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then add the peppers and carrot. Cook for 3–4 minutes until slightly softened.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: Add sweet chilli sauce and soy sauce to the pan. Stir and let it simmer for 1 minute.

method.title: Combine everything
method.text: Add the cooked chicken and noodles back to the pan. Toss everything together until well coated in the sticky sauce.

method.title: Serve
method.text: Top with chopped spring onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

tip: Add a squeeze of lime or a pinch of chilli flakes if you like a bit of extra heat!
notes: No total, per-serving cost or calories printed (ingredient prices add up to £9.80). Sticker 'SWEET STICKY BETTER THAN TAKEAWAY' (not used as subtitle). Equipment: large pan or wok, colander, knife, chopping board, wooden spoon.

title: Sweet Chilli Chicken Rice Bowl

method.title: Cook the rice
method.text: Rinse rice, then cook according to packet instructions (10–12 mins). Set aside.

method.title: Prepare the chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt, pepper and a little garlic. Cook in a pan with a drizzle of oil until golden and cooked through.

method.title: Add the veg
method.text: Add sliced pepper, broccoli and carrot to the pan. Stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until tender but still crisp.

method.title: Add the sauce
method.text: Pour in the sweet chilli sauce and a splash of soy sauce. Stir well and let it simmer for 2–3 minutes until everything is coated.

method.title: Serve
method.text: Add the rice to a bowl, top with the chicken and veg. Finish with spring onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

title: Sweet Chilli Halloumi Wraps

method.title: Cook the halloumi
method.text: Slice the halloumi into thick strips and pan-fry in a little oil over a medium heat until golden on all sides.

method.title: Prep the veg
method.text: Grate the carrot and slice the cucumber.

method.title: Warm the wraps
method.text: Heat the wraps in a dry frying pan for 30 seconds on each side or in the microwave until soft and pliable.

method.title: Fill the wraps
method.text: Add a layer of lettuce, grated carrot, cucumber, golden halloumi and a drizzle of sweet chilli sauce (plus mayo or yogurt if using).

method.title: Roll up & serve
method.text: Fold in the sides, roll up tightly and serve straight away.

tip: Add a squeeze of lime for extra freshness.
